name: markvoro-support-agent
description: Railway build orchestration: builds the widget, copies it into the backend's public/ folder, then builds the backend. Deployed with rootDirectory=support-agent.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix widget && npm run build --prefix widget && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('backend/public',{recursive:true});fs.copyFileSync('widget/dist/widget.js','backend/public/widget.js');" && npm run build --prefix backend
